integrity: Primary indefinite-core blow-up example and its pointwise consequence acknowledged as prior work; risk-optimal ridge and strict hard-cutoff comparison are the specific quantitative contribution; independent priority and correctness assessment not performed.
scientific_limitations: No universal optimality for arbitrary indefinite matrices, unnormalized sketches, alternative losses, additional sketch columns, or finite-precision methods; oracle needs spectral magnitude; newer relevant full text remains a comparison risk.

title: Exact mean-square ridge stabilization of rank-one indefinite Nyström
